notes.title: Big Visual Overhaul
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have been hard at work the last few months and overhauled the whole game.

First of all, we fixed a lot of audio differences between the locations and scenes!
That was one of the bigger feedback points from the community.

A more apparent change though, is that we changed most of the visuals to fit our vision of the scenes and the mood more. It also is more stylized that way and we are very happy how it turned out.

We also did some minor bug fixes.

The update is perfectly on time with the Summer-Sale!
We hope you have fun playing!

I hope you enjoy our revised version of the game!

Kind Regards,
Flimmersoft.

notes.title: Author-Playthrough on Twitch
notes.content:
Today at 10:30 am CET the Author and main protagonist of Ghosts of the Past will Stream the game the first time on his [url=http://www.twitch.tv/isakucosplay]Twitch Channel[/url]. 

The Stream will be held in german language. We will though record another playthrough of both producers playing the game and talking about it on YouTube soon in English! If you have questions about the game/story/characters, come and join the stream today.

notes.title: Patchnotes
notes.content:
Bugs fixed:
We fixed issues with the dialogue showing up twice or not at all in certain areas.

Quality of life update:
We added a skip button to the puzzles to make the game more accessible.
We have reworked all newspapers to make them easier to read.

What will come up next:
We are working on an update regarding audio and color grading.

Thank you all for your patience and support!

Michael & Paul
Team Flimmersoft

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
We again fixed some smaller bugs, and also fixed an issue blocking two achievements, "Mirror Mirror" and "Not without my coffee" should now be achievable.
Thank you for your patience.
Kind Regards 
Flimmersoft

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We fixed a few minor bugs, regarding inventory and interaction issues.
The issues for demo player where the language settings are broken, should also be fixed now for all new players, for anyone who still has issues regarding language settings: we pinned a post in the community hub with a fix.
Thank you all for your understanding that this is our first big release and that we still needed to polish a few things.
Kind Regards 
Flimmersoft
